text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads up — ops flagged a sustained embeddings latency spike affecting hosted API and a few Dedicated clusters. We need a short, staged customer comms plan (status page + email + enterprise pings).

Priya Patel: Thanks — can you share the incident link and ETA? We should decide timing: immediate status page update (minimal) + full update in 1 hr? Also need guidance on webinar scheduled in 2 days — postpone or note possible Q&A drift. :thinking_face:

StatusBot: Incident created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2148005555 — Impact: increased embeddings latency for some customers; teams investigating.

Jon Ortega: Root cause unknown yet, currently rolling back a recent model routing tweak as a mitigation. No data exfil. ETA unknown, will update every 30–45m.

Liam Brooks: For messaging, let's avoid technical jargon. Suggested initial status page copy (short):

"We are investigating increased latency affecting embeddings generation. Some requests may be slower than usual. Our engineers are actively investigating and mitigating impact. We will post updates within the hour."

Priya Patel: That reads well. Suggest a follow-up update template (30–60m):

"Update: We have identified a performance regression tied to a routing change. We are rolling back the change and observing recovery. No customer data impacted. Estimated recovery window: ~30–60 minutes. We will confirm when service is fully recovered."

Maya Chen: Good. For enterprise customers (contracts/SLA) — propose targeted DM/email at first recovery confirmation, and a dedicated thread for any who ask for a timeline. Priya, can you approve copy for email?

Priya Patel: I can do email copy. Keep it concise and actionable. Draft for review below: 

"Short update: We experienced increased latency for embeddings. Our engineers identified a routing regression and are rolling back the change. We expect recovery shortly. We’ll follow up when the service returns to normal and provide a root cause summary. If you need immediate support, reply to this message or contact your CSM."

Jon Ortega: Ops asks that marketing avoid claims like "restored" until metrics show baseline for two consecutive 5-minute windows. We’ll flag when that condition is met.

Priya Patel: Noted. We'll schedule staged messages:
- Now: minimal status page + pinned banner in Support Center.
- +30–45m: status update with rollback progress.
- Recovery: confirmation + email to enterprise list.
- Postmortem/RCAs: 24–48h follow-up with more details.

Maya Chen: Who owns publishing the status page? Priya or Ops? Also need translations for EU customers (FR/DE).

Priya Patel: Marketing will publish the status page copy (short) once Ops posts the incident link and confirms the wording. I’ll coordinate translations with localization (quick FR/DE). If recovery protracted, escalate to legal for messaging on SLAs.

Liam Brooks: Webinar note: keep scheduled but add a banner in registration email: "We are monitoring an intermittent issue with embeddings; the webinar will proceed as planned — we'll address any product questions live and follow up if we need to reschedule." Avoid postponing unless issue persists past 24h.

Maya Chen: Routing of inbound leads: runbook says route impacted customers to CSM tier-2 if they mention latency or SLA. Sales ops — please make sure SDRs have the one-liner and a link to the enterprise inbox.

Priya Patel: I'll prepare the SDR snippet: 

"TL;DR — we're investigating increased embeddings latency. Engineers are rolling back a routing change; expected recovery soon. If the customer is on Dedicated/Private, escalate to your CSM. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2148005555"

Jon Ortega: Will update here with metrics. Next check-in in 30m.

StatusBot: Incident updated: mitigation in progress — rollback started.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. Priya — once you publish initial status copy, post the permalink here so ops/sales can reference it. We'll keep updates short and timestamped. :thumbsup:
